title: In multiple functions of hppsfilter.c, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to a stack buffer… (CVE-2026-58966)
description: CVE-2026-58966 is a vulnerability involving a possible out-of-bounds write caused by a stack buffer overflow in multiple functions of the hppsfilter.c source file. This flaw can lead to local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
